title: P$^2$-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
abstract: arXiv:2611.03953v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P$^2$-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within the span of the frozen student and expert parameters for any choice of merging coefficients, P$^2$-MOPD keeps the student trainable, so the experts act as parameter priors without confining it to this span. Across four domains at 1.7B and 4B scales, P$^2$-MOPD achieves faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD from the same initialization, surpassing its final average recovery in half the training steps. tldr: 该论文提出 P$^2$-MOPD，将学生与专家参数的线性组合视为一个可微模型，在在线策略蒸馏目标下联合优化混合系数与学生权重，使专家作为参数先验而非限制学生，从而在四个领域上仅用一半训练步数就实现了比 MOPD 更快、更均衡的能力恢复。
en_tdlr: P$^2$-MOPD treats the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model, jointly optimizing mixing coefficients and student weights under the on-policy distillation objective so that experts act as parameter priors rather than constraints, achieving faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD in half the training steps across four domains.
